arts.name: Packet Pipeline
arts.shows: A packet runs along six stages and lights each one it passes.
arts.use: Shows a job moving through its steps: a build, an order or an onboarding flow.

arts.name: Chase Ring
arts.shows: Three dots chase each other round a ring, the leader brightest.
arts.use: A loading indicator for a button, a card or a whole screen while data arrives.

arts.name: Hop Trio
arts.shows: Three dots hop one after another, like someone thinking.
arts.use: The 'still working on it' moment in a chat or an AI reply.

arts.name: Scope Wave
arts.shows: An oscilloscope trace that shifts as the signal changes.
arts.use: Pages about hardware, sensors, audio or anything that gets measured.

arts.name: Heartbeat Line
arts.shows: A heart monitor trace that keeps running across the screen.
arts.use: Uptime pages, health checks and monitoring dashboards.

arts.name: Ripple
arts.shows: Rings spread outward from one bright point.
arts.use: An empty state, or a screen waiting for a device to connect.

arts.name: Radar Sweep
arts.shows: A beam turns around a round screen and leaves fading blips.
arts.use: Search and discovery screens: finding devices, people or results nearby.

arts.name: Equaliser
arts.shows: Columns of dots bounce like an audio level meter.
arts.use: Audio players, podcasts and voice features.

arts.name: Turning Cube
arts.shows: A wireframe cube turning to show every side.
arts.use: Pages about building blocks: platforms, SDKs and 3D work.

arts.name: Merging Rings
arts.shows: Two rings drift together until they overlap, then part.
arts.use: Integrations and partnerships, or anything that joins two systems.

arts.name: Spiral
arts.shows: A spiral arm winds outward and keeps turning.
arts.use: A calm loader, or a focal point in a landing section.

arts.name: Lissajous
arts.shows: A Lissajous curve whose loops slowly shift as the phase drifts.
arts.use: Electronics and engineering pages that want a lab feel.

arts.name: Plasma
arts.shows: Soft blobs of brightness flow and mix across the grid.
arts.use: A soft moving backdrop behind a hero headline.

arts.name: Truchet Tiles
arts.shows: Quarter-circle tiles flip one by one and redraw the maze.
arts.use: A patterned background for developer tools and puzzle games.

arts.name: Network
arts.shows: A network with pulses travelling along its links.
arts.use: Infrastructure, APIs and connected systems.

arts.name: Neural Net
arts.shows: A small neural network with signals running from inputs to outputs.
arts.use: AI features, model pages and machine-learning products.

arts.name: Database
arts.shows: A stack of database disks, each written to in turn.
arts.use: Data storage, backups and sync features.

arts.name: Chip
arts.shows: A chip with pins, sending signal rings outward.
arts.use: IoT, embedded systems and hardware products.

arts.name: Rising Bars
arts.shows: Bars rise to their measured height against a dashed target line.
arts.use: Analytics, reports and goal tracking.

arts.name: Layers
arts.shows: Three platform layers breathe apart and settle again.
arts.use: Platforms and stacks: anything built in tiers.

arts.name: App Window
arts.shows: An app window whose selected row moves down the list.
arts.use: Software products and app showcases.

arts.name: Gear
arts.shows: A gear turning steadily, bright rim and dim body.
arts.use: Settings screens, automation and engineering services.

arts.name: Shield Scan
arts.shows: A shield with a tick, and a scan line passing over it.
arts.use: Security, privacy and trust pages.

arts.name: Typing Bubble
arts.shows: A message bubble with someone typing.
arts.use: Chat, support and 'someone is typing' states.

arts.name: Checklist
arts.shows: A checklist that ticks itself off, line by line.
arts.use: Onboarding, task lists and setup progress.

arts.name: Done Tick
arts.shows: A circle draws itself, then a tick appears inside it.
arts.use: Success screens after a payment, a sign-up or a saved form.

arts.name: Upload
arts.shows: An arrow rises out of a tray, again and again.
arts.use: File upload areas and sync status.

arts.shows: The number 404 in a dot font, with a scan line passing down.
arts.use: A 404 page that still looks like the rest of your product.

arts.name: Typing Page
arts.shows: A page whose lines type themselves out, then start over.
arts.use: Writing, publishing and documentation tools.

arts.name: Marquee
arts.shows: Your own text scrolling across, like an LED sign.
arts.use: Announcements, ticker strips and event signs, in your own words.

arts.name: Clock
arts.shows: A digital clock showing the viewer's local time, its colon blinking.
arts.use: Status screens, kiosks and dashboards that show the time.

arts.name: Rainfall
arts.shows: Rain falls in thin streaks and splashes where it lands.
arts.use: Weather apps and calm, rainy backdrops.

arts.name: Sunrise
arts.shows: The sun rises over the horizon while its rays turn slowly.
arts.use: Morning check-ins, travel and wellness apps.

arts.name: Orbit Core
arts.shows: A dense core with three nodes on a tilted orbit.
arts.use: AI products, or anything with a core and moving parts.

arts.name: Ringed Planet
arts.shows: A planet with a tilted ring that passes in front of it and behind.
arts.use: Space themes, science content and kids' learning apps.

arts.name: Comet
arts.shows: A comet streaks past the stars, its tail fading behind it.
arts.use: Launch banners and 'something new' announcements.

arts.name: Fireflies
arts.shows: Small lights wander about and blink on and off.
arts.use: A gentle night-time background for calm pages.

arts.name: Pendulum Wave
arts.shows: A row of pendulums swings at slightly different speeds and forms waves.
arts.use: A banner about timing, rhythm or physics.

arts.name: Fireworks
arts.shows: Rockets rise and burst into rings of sparks that fade.
arts.use: Launch days, New Year and success screens.

arts.name: Heart
arts.shows: A heart that beats and sends out a ring with each beat.
arts.use: Likes, favourites and thank-you pages.

arts.name: Warp Stars
arts.shows: Stars stream out from the centre, as if at warp speed.
arts.use: A fast-moving hero for launches and sci-fi themes.

arts.name: Breathing Grid
arts.shows: The grid brightens and dims in slow waves from the centre.
arts.use: A quiet backdrop behind a sign-in form.
